title: Tell eligible sessions when their project declares Engram but the integration is disabled
outcome: Observed by Engram::Advisor (session-6219, Codex, project Engram) on 2026-09-05: no Engram MCP tools, ENGRAM_HOME/ACTOR_ID/SESSION_ID unset while TERMAL_SESSION_ID was present; engram work next failed with "pass --home or set ENGRAM_HOME". Root cause was operator state, not an injection gap: the Engram project had been disabled in Settings > Engram for the developer-name change and only PhoenixCodeNav was re-enabled (verified read-only on /api/state). The gap is that a session in a declared-but-disabled project gets no signal at all and may try to guess a store or identity. Desired: when a project declares .engram-project but Engram is disabled (or verification never passed), eligible sessions receive one explicit line (in the seeded instructions and/or the first-turn context) saying Engram integration is unavailable for this project and why, and must not initialize a separate store or borrow another session identity. Acceptance: a session started in a declared-but-disabled project sees the notice; an enabled project is unchanged; test covers both.
